newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST-Taiwan Q4 1996 GDP growth - Reuters Poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Taiwan Q4 1996 GDP growth - Reuters Poll.

text.p: The following Reuters Poll of Taiwan economists gives their projections for year-on-year growth of Taiwan gross domestic product (GDP) in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The figures were tentatively scheduled for release by the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics at 0900 GMT on February 20.
The Reuters Poll produced an average forecast for a rise of 6.19 percent for fourth quarter GDP growth, well below the statistics directorate's November forecast of 6.58 percent.
None of the economists polled expected quarterly growth to achieve the government forecast.
Economists said the government was overly optimistic on growth of private investment and other GDP components.
"In fact, private investment was still pretty slow in the fourth quarter," said Grand Cathay Securities vice-president Terry Chen. "The directorate was too optimistic."

Economists nonetheless noted gradually improving private consumption and state expenditure, supporting expectations that fourth-quarter GDP growth would rebound to six percent or above from disappointingly slow third-quarter growth of 5.61 percent.
